domains.target: GitHub Pages marketing project via Cloudflare DNS
GitHub Pages status shell via Cloudflare DNS

domains.purpose: Public-safe status, install, or identity helper paths

domains.target: GitHub Pages MkDocs deployment via Cloudflare DNS

bootstrap_steps: Point heiwa.ltd at the GitHub Pages marketing project through Cloudflare DNS only.
Point status.heiwa.ltd at the GitHub Pages status shell through Cloudflare DNS only.
Point docs.heiwa.ltd at the GitHub Pages docs project built from MkDocs Material.
Keep runtime control on the installed local heiwa runtime rather than a hosted product shell.
Attach api.heiwa.ltd only to public-safe helper paths such as status, install delivery, or identity exchange.
Keep canonical evidence in the local JSONL journal; Lance remains derived and rebuildable.
Keep internal preview runtimes such as heiwa-trading off the supported public host manifest until they graduate into first-class product surfaces.
Use Cloudflare for DNS only; public Pages TLS remains owned by the publishing target.
Run post-cutover checks for api.heiwa.ltd/health, status.heiwa.ltd, and public page endpoints.
